lc_person: Albert Anthony Giesecke, educator and rector of the University of Cuzco; author of American commercial legislation before 1789 (1910); LC dates 1880-1968.
item_person: Albert Giesecke, educator and rector of the University of San Antonio Abad del Cusco; Wikidata dates 1883-1968.

evidence.says: LC identifies Albert Anthony Giesecke (1880-1968), citing American commercial legislation before 1789 (1910). Its title-page note identifies the author as president of the University of Cuzco and former political-science instructor at Cornell and Pennsylvania. Although the heading and structured birth date use 1880, another source note reports 1883.

The item is labelled Albert Giesecke, described as a teacher, and records birth in 1883 and death in 1968. P244 is no98084491; VIAF is 108797854 and ISNI is 0000000081737530. Its linked encyclopedia article identifies him as the rector of the University of San Antonio Abad del Cusco.

Colección de tesis de la Universidad del Cusco sustentadas en el rectorado del Dr. Albert A. Giesecke (1910-1923), ISHRA, pp. 14-15, gives birth year 1883 and identifies his Cornell doctoral thesis as American Commercial Legislation before 1789, defended in 1908 and published in 1910. The article draws on his Columbia oral history and archival documents. This matches the supplied AHA dissertation subject, institution and year.

The Ministry of Culture archival directory entry for the Instituto Riva-Agüero Colección Giesecke identifies Albert Anthony Giesecke and gives birth year 1883, corroborating the university journal account and the source cited for Wikidata’s birth statement.

notes: Same person: the 1908 Cornell dissertation and its 1910 publication connect the graph entry to LC and to the Cusco rector. Institutional biographical sources support 1883 over LC’s 1880; LC itself contains the conflicting year in a source note. No replacement QID is needed. LC and Wikidata were read through their public JSON representations; the journal article was read in its publisher-hosted PDF.
